Written by the DSL course sync from templates/site/ in the # toolkit; every sync rewrites it. layout: page --- {{ content }} {% comment %} Your Profile - the three settings that let every other page offer a file in the student's own copy (see _includes/open_in.html, which owns the URL rules and is included below so that this page's own buttons derive a path exactly the way a file row does). One static page, no back end: the site is public and identical for everybody, so what it learns here it keeps in the reader's own browser (localStorage) and sends nowhere. Fields save as they are typed - there is no Save button to forget to press - and a button whose inputs are missing is greyed with the line that says which. The materials repo is named once here, as the default a cohort release deploys into (`cohort_dest_repo`, dsl_course/deploy.py). Nothing else on this page depends on it: the per-file control reads the repo out of each file's own GitHub URL, so a course that renamed its materials repo still gets working file links and only these two buttons point at the default name. {% endcomment %}
